files.last_cycle.json: Manager writes after each run cycle — timestamps, status, gaps
files.data_cache.json: Researcher writes — latest fetched FRED, market, RSS data
files.analyst_baseline.json: Analyst writes — previous key levels + prediction log
files.alert_history.json: AlertMonitor writes — escalated events, known headlines
files.thinker_state.json: Thinker writes — approved/rejected improvements, strategic notes
files.design_decisions.json: Designer writes — layout and style decisions
files.task_history.jsonl: Manager appends — one line per completed cycle
files.pending_approvals/: Any agent writes — decisions awaiting Larry's input

rules.read_access: all agents may read all files
